name: Cave crawlers

variantInfo.name: Cave crawler
notes: Standard level 23 cave crawler (npc 406-409); the Slayer-task target.
Cave crawlers are poisonous (poison level 8); bring antipoison.
An icy variant (npc 13800-13801) with a 50% fire weakness exists but is not the standard task target.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Cave crawlers)
notes: Most common cave crawler location; no light source required, unlike the swamp caves.
Spawn count not stated on the wiki (honest UNKNOWN).

locationComparison.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
notes: Alternative location; requires a rope to enter and a light source inside.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here.
A ranged/mage safespot exists between a stalactite and a gas hole in the Lumbridge caves.
Spawn count not stated on the wiki (honest UNKNOWN).

taskNotes: Cave crawlers are assigned by Turael, Spria, and Mazchna and require 10 Slayer.
Cave crawlers are poisonous (poison level 8); an antipoison is recommended.
They have 22 hitpoints and a max hit of 3; the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon needs no light source, while the Lumbridge Swamp Caves require a rope and a light source.
The standard cave crawler (npc 406-409) is level 23; an icy variant (npc 13800-13801) with a 50% fire weakness exists but is not the standard task target.
The slayerTargetId 280 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist section 1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The wikiPageId was not captured at authoring time (honest UNKNOWN); sourceUrl is https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cave_crawler.
recommendedMethod: Fight cave crawlers in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (no light source needed) with any melee weapon; they have 22 HP and a max hit of 3. Bring an antipoison as they are poisonous.
